newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP iron ore output rises in Sept.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP iron ore output rises in Sept.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday that its Australian iron ore production rose eight percent in September compared with September 1995 due to the introduction of a seven train roster at Mt. Newman.
Production of Australian iron ore on a year-to-date basis rose as a result of the new train roster and higher tonnages at the Yandi mine, BHP said in its mineral division production report.
Shipments of Australian iron ore were higher as a result of strong customer demand, it said.
Queensland coal output was 14 percent higher than a year-earlier as a result of preparation plant shutdowns at Saraji and Moura in September 1995, BHP said.
U.S. coal production was higher due to the shut down of the San Juan generating station a year earlier while Indonesian coal output was lower, in part to fleet availability and bad weather at Satui.
However, Indonesian coal production was higher on a year-to- date basis due to higher recovery rates.
BHP Minerals division output (million tonnes unless stated)
NOTE: September is the fourth month of BHP's financial year.
